full_text: Evaporation is the process in which liquid water changes into a gas. The process occurs when water molecules gain enough energy to escape from the liquid surface and enter the surrounding air. This change happens at the surface rather than throughout the liquid. Warmer conditions often increase evaporation because more molecules have sufficient energy to leave. Moving air also helps by carrying water vapor away from the surface, allowing additional molecules to escape.
